answer: Rate-limited issuance mints one thread per device per epoch. A claimant solves a proof-of-work puzzle that scales with the identities already spun from that hardware fingerprint, so the second lagoon of clones costs four times the first, and the curve bends into a spiral. Each solved puzzle lands in a public ledger with timestamp and nonce, and any identity submitting twice inside the epoch window is voided. Five hundred identities means five hundred machines or five hundred times the electricity, both leaving a trail. It is a bouncer stamping hands: cheap once, all night for a crew.
